publication_rule: Candidates remain approval-gated and are not checkout-enabled until explicitly approved.

offers.name: Commander Deck Diagnostic
offers.problem: A Commander player wants a focused external assessment of deck strategy, consistency, and performance.
offers.input: Commander deck list supplied by the customer.
offers.refund_policy: Use the canonical product refund policy when checkout is approved.
offers.eligibility: Customer must supply a usable Commander deck list.

offers.name: BEC-PRIME Architecture Audit
offers.problem: A founder needs an independent assessment of a local-first AI commerce system and its monetization readiness.
offers.input: System description, architecture artifacts, deployment constraints, and commercial goals.
offers.output: Structured architecture audit with risks, bottlenecks, and prioritized implementation actions.
offers.buyer: Founder, operator, or technical product owner
offers.refund_policy: Apply the published checkout policy; delivery is not represented as complete before verified fulfillment.
offers.eligibility: Customer can provide sufficient system information for a meaningful audit.

offers.name: Agent-Readiness Audit
offers.problem: A business wants to know whether its products and services are discoverable, understandable, and purchasable by software agents.
offers.input: Product catalog, policies, fulfillment rules, checkout surface, and relevant APIs.
offers.output: Machine-readability and agent-commerce readiness report with prioritized gaps.
offers.refund_policy: Define and publish the canonical policy before fulfilment disputes are handled.
offers.eligibility: Customer controls or can authorize review of the relevant commerce surface.
